ns2:section.sectionText: Topic Section B: Speculative Futures / Science Fiction Our future is—and has always been—uncertain. In this course we’ll read science fiction and speculative fiction by some of your favorite authors: Margaret Atwood, China Mieville, Kate Wilhelm, Philip K. Dick, Arthur C. Clarke, H.G. Wells, Max Brooks, and many more; we’ll watch some films and some TV shows; we may even work through some graphic novels. Our primary goal: what do our visions of the future tell us about the state of the world—historically and in the present day? What kinds of questions, ideas, and problems motivate the future? What roles does technology play in these visions? Who gets to construct our future and why?
